newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BPI hits highs on results optimism.
newsitem.headline: BPI hits highs on results optimism.

text.p: Shares in Portuguese bank Banco Portugues de Investimento-SGPS hit highs around 2,445 escudos as investors believed that 1996 results would be much better than expected, dealers said.
BPI shares stood at 2,445 escudos, up 115, in volume of 108,915 shares at 1522 GMT.
"In the market people are saying that 1996 results will be much better than expected. On average analysts were expecting net consolidated profit of 15 billion escudos," an operator said.
Another said: "Some people are expecting BPI to make a profit of 20 billion escudos."
BPI is expected to announce its 1996 results in the last week of February, an official source in the bank said.
